name: Ilvareth Dusksong
languages: Common plus five other languages, Elvish, Undercommon

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: Ilvareth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Misty Step (3/Day)
abilities.description: As a bonus action, Ilvareth casts *misty step*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

abilities.name: Protective Magic (3/Day) (Reaction)
abilities.description: When Ilvareth is hit by an attack roll, Ilvareth casts *shield* in response, gaining a +5 bonus to AC until the start of its next turn, including against the triggering attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ilvareth makes four Arcane Burst attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Duskblind.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
Ilvareth casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

At will:: *detect magic*, *detect thoughts*, *disguise self*, *invisibility*, *light*, *mage armor*, *mage hand*, *prestidigitation*
2/day each:: *fly*, *lightning bolt*
1/day each:: *cone of cold*, *mind blank*, *scrying*, *teleport*

actions.name: Duskblind
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet of Ilvareth must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of Ilvareth's next turn.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) force damage.
